body:
About the purpose of the widget: what does it means to have a "free shipping" toggle?
- when on: show me only the free shipping items
- when off: show me both free and not free shipping

The thing is that for some other properties it may not be what the user wants to express.
If I have an `archive` boolean attribute for my store, does the toggle means:
- when on: show me only the archived items
- when off: show me only the active (non archived) items

Or does it means:
- when on: show me only the archived items
- when off: show me both
